description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Regulations made to amend the United Nations Regulations No. 2 of 2012 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1760/40 of 31.05.2012
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs under the United Nations Act, No. 45 of 1968. It specifically amends existing United Nations Regulations and deals with legal/regulatory matters concerning international sanctions regimes and counter-terrorism measures imposed by UN Security Council resolutions. The content focuses entirely on legal frameworks, regulatory amendments, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
